R.name: Realistic
R.desc: Practical and hands-on. You like working with tools, machines, the outdoors or anything you can see and touch, and you prefer clear, tangible results.

I.name: Investigative
I.desc: Curious and analytical. You enjoy understanding how things work, solving complex problems and making decisions based on evidence.

A.name: Artistic
A.desc: Imaginative and expressive. You value originality and enjoy work where you can create, design or communicate ideas in your own way.

S.name: Social
S.desc: Warm and people-focused. You enjoy helping, teaching and supporting others, and you are good at building trust and understanding what people need.

E.name: Enterprising
E.desc: Energetic and ambitious. You enjoy leading, influencing and persuading others, and you are motivated by goals, rewards and new opportunities.

C.name: Conventional
C.desc: Organised and dependable. You like clear procedures, accuracy and order, and you take pride in doing things properly and on time.

R.name: 实际型
R.desc: 务实、喜欢动手。你喜欢使用工具、机器，或在户外工作，喜欢看得见、摸得着的事物，并偏好清晰具体的成果。

I.name: 研究型
I.desc: 好奇、善于分析。你喜欢了解事物如何运作、解决复杂问题，并根据证据做决定。

A.name: 艺术型
A.desc: 富有想象力、善于表达。你重视原创性，喜欢能以自己的方式创作、设计或传达想法的工作。

S.name: 社会型
S.desc: 热情、以人为本。你喜欢帮助、教导和支持他人，善于建立信任并了解别人的需要。

E.name: 企业型
E.desc: 精力充沛、有抱负。你喜欢领导、影响和说服他人，并以目标、回报和新机会为动力。

C.name: 常规型
C.desc: 有条理、可靠。你喜欢清晰的程序、准确和秩序，并以把事情做好、准时完成为荣。
